description: This Java class defines the LoanProductConfigurableAttributes entity for Fineract, representing configurable attributes of a loan product such as amortization method, interest type, and grace periods. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON commands, populating defaults, getter/setter methods, and equality/hashcode implementations.

classes.name: LoanProductConfigurableAttributes
classes.description: Entity class representing configurable attributes for a loan product, including attributes like amortization, interest method, and grace periods, with methods to create, update, and compare instances.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JsonCommand, extracting boolean attribute flags from nested JSON objects.

methods.name: updateLoanProduct
methods.description: Associates this configurable attributes object with a specific LoanProduct.

methods.name: populateDefaultsForConfigurableAttributes
methods.description: Creates an instance with default boolean attribute values set to true.

methods.name: getAllowedLoanConfigurableAttributes
methods.description: Returns an array of supported configurable attribute names.
